findings.current: *It’ll be a pain in the ass if that bastard posted anything stupid.*
findings.defect: The draft replaces the narrator’s deliberately crude image of the Skeleton King leaving shit behind with the sanitized and generic “anything stupid.”
findings.rationale: 똥이라도 싸 놨으면 is explicitly scatological and establishes the profanity and comic register of Taekyung’s concern.
findings.replacement: *It’ll be a pain in the ass if that bastard left some shit on there.*

findings.current: Even the Alliance Leader couldn’t do that.
findings.defect: The draft omits 무림 and turns the specific Murim Alliance Leader into a generic Alliance Leader.
findings.rationale: 무림맹주 specifically denotes the leader of the Murim Alliance, and the binding terminology requires “Murim Alliance.”
findings.replacement: Even the Murim Alliance Leader couldn’t do that.

findings.current: If I say I don’t like it, doesn’t that make me the only bad woman here?
findings.defect: “Bad woman” is unnatural English and sanitizes the coarse, self-directed 년, weakening Song Song’s blunt register.
findings.rationale: 나쁜 년 is a profane characterization, while 싫다고 하면 means refusing or saying she does not want to do it, not merely saying she dislikes it.
findings.replacement: If I say I don’t want to, doesn’t that make me the only bitch here?
findings.source: 들어 보니까 결국 모두를 위해서 하는 일인데, 싫다고 하면 나만 나쁜 년 되는 거 아냐?

findings.current: Ever since I beat the Lich in China, my name had become known throughout the world.
findings.defect: The draft drops 아크, changing the defeated monster from an Arch Lich to an ordinary Lich.
findings.rationale: 아크 리치 explicitly identifies the monster as an Arch Lich; omitting the modifier loses its classification and stature.
findings.replacement: Ever since I took down the Arch Lich in China, my name had become known throughout the world.
findings.source: 나는 중국에서 아크 리치를 때려잡은 후부터 전 세계에 이름을 알렸고,

findings.current: I wasn’t planning to leave before that, either.
findings.defect: The draft treats 그전에 as an unclear chronological “before that,” obscuring Im Kkeokjeong’s point that he never intended to withdraw regardless of whether it was already too late.
findings.rationale: In response to Song Song saying it is already too late to pull out, Im states that he had no intention of doing so even before reaching that point.
findings.replacement: I never intended to pull out in the first place.

findings.current: At least for the sake of those who left before us.
findings.defect: The draft pluralizes the singular 사람, implying multiple departed people instead of the one specific person whose absence immediately becomes the focus.
findings.rationale: 사람 is singular here, and the following passage centers on one person’s empty place and grave.
findings.replacement: At least for the sake of the one who left us first.

findings.defect: “The cemetery” broadens 산소 from the specific person’s grave or gravesite to an entire cemetery.
findings.rationale: 산소 refers to a grave or gravesite in this context, reinforced by the immediately following gravestone.

findings.current: So next time, I’d like us all to go and visit her together.
findings.defect: The draft adds the gendered pronoun “her,” although 그분 is honorific and gender-neutral; this introduces identity information absent from the source.
findings.rationale: 그분 supplies respect but no gender, and the binding terminology specifically maps it to “that person.”
findings.replacement: So next time, I’d like all of us to go visit that person together.
findings.source: 해서 다음에는 모두 함께 그분을 뵈러 갔으면 합니다.

findings.current: We had already finished the rough discussion before bringing it up.
findings.defect: “Before bringing it up” contradicts the scene, since the group has just spent the conversation discussing the proposal. The source says the broad preliminary discussion was already complete before they moved ahead.
findings.rationale: The sentence marks the preceding conversation as sufficient preliminary discussion before Team Leader Choi begins making calls; it does not place that discussion before the subject was raised.
findings.replacement: We had already worked out the broad strokes beforehand.
findings.source: 말하기에 앞서 이미 대강의 논의는 끝내 놓은 상태.

findings.current: “Damn it. This isn’t some Ddong Gae drill……”
findings.defect: The draft mistakes the common idiom 똥개 훈련 for the proper name Ddong Gae, producing an unintelligible line.
findings.rationale: 똥개 훈련 refers to being needlessly made to repeat actions or run back and forth, which fits the department head ordering emergency measures only for the power to return immediately.
findings.replacement: “Damn it. They’ve got us running around in circles……”
findings.source: 젠장. 이건 뭐 똥개 훈련도 아니고…….

summary: The draft adds a gender not present in the source, pluralizes a singular deceased person, alters Im Kkeokjeong’s commitment, drops the Arch Lich’s rank, and mistranslates an idiom as a proper name. Several lines also soften the source’s profanity or omit established terminology.
